_note: programId is the real keypair pubkey (target/deploy) synced into declare_id!/Anchor.toml; devnet deploy pending SOL funding. Session 1 (build lane) owns this file post-deploy. usdcMint is the devnet USDC-Dev faucet mint; the crank reads the authoritative mint from the on-chain Config account and only falls back to this value.
_testUsdcMintNote: testUsdcMint is the 6-decimal TEST mint created by setup-devnet.ts (authority = the first team wallet). The team wallets in `wallets` hold THIS mint, not the shared devnet USDC-Dev mint in `usdcMint`. initialize_config MUST set Config.usdc_mint = testUsdcMint, or lock_purchase fails the InvalidMint constraint.
